decisions: Do not enlarge the architecture by changing focal length.
Broaden gable shoulders while retaining the measured crown; lower the front arris at its ends.
Move rear triangular infill behind actual spaced timber ribs to restore vault depth.
Replace the unrelated smooth slate face with a cropped CC0 granite face at its published metric scale.
Use 140 mm solid slabs with 28 mm actual rounded arrises, settling, crowns, shallow wear and independent tilt.
